label: Hypoxia/HIF signalling and glycolytic reprogramming
reason: HIF-1alpha oxygen sensing linked to glycolysis/fructose-2,6-bisphosphate control, with p53/mTORC1 metabolic regulation of the same programme.

label: Chemosensation and nociception: taste, smell, pain
reason: Taste, olfaction, itch and pain perception linked as sensory transduction via receptors and TRP/K2P channels setting sensory neuron excitability.

label: Negative regulation of TLR/IL-1/NF-kB inflammation
reason: All members restrain innate inflammatory signalling and pro-inflammatory cytokine production.

label: Cardiac chamber and septum morphogenesis
reason: Trabeculation, compact myocardium, septum and endocardium development of the heart.

label: Endothelial specification and vascular morphogenesis
reason: Endothelial fate, arterial/venous/lymphatic identity, Tie2 and neuropilin-VEGF signalling in vessel formation.

label: Axon guidance, growth and regeneration
reason: Semaphorin/netrin repulsion, axon extension, collateral sprouting and regeneration; ceramide signalling is a minor outlier.

label: APC/C and G2/M mitotic cell-cycle control
reason: APC/C-mediated degradation, Cdk1/cyclin control and G2/M checkpoint events of the mitotic cycle.

label: Stress MAPK (JNK/p38) and AP-1 immediate-early response
reason: TAK1-JNK/p38 activation, AP-1 transcription and growth-factor immediate-early/TNF-NFkB response genes form one stress-kinase programme.

label: Gi/Gz GPCR adenylate cyclase signalling
reason: Alpha-2 adrenergic and Gi/Gz-mediated cAMP inhibition, second-messenger GPCR signalling and secretion control.

label: Leukocyte adhesion and transendothelial migration
reason: Integrin activation, endothelial adhesion, PECAM1 and diapedesis of leukocytes; Nef is a minor outlier.

label: Glial activation and amyloid-beta processing
reason: Microglia/astrocyte activation and APP/amyloid/tau regulation form an Alzheimer core, but obsolete amide-metabolism terms and axon regeneration (~a third) are uninformative misfits.

label: Ventral neural tube patterning and motor neurons
reason: Notochord/floor plate signalling patterning the neural tube and specifying spinal motor neurons and interneurons.

label: E2F/RB cell-cycle progression and checkpoints
reason: E2F/RB G1/S transcription, G2/M transition and checkpoint signalling; arginine histone methylation is a lone outlier.

label: Neuropeptide control of innate behaviours and sleep
reason: Sleep/wake, mating, parental, aggressive and stress behaviours linked by neuropeptide signalling (orexin, relaxin, etc.).

label: Mitochondrial respiration, ROS and intrinsic apoptosis
reason: Regulation of oxidative phosphorylation and ATP synthesis linked to ROS/oxidative-stress-induced mitochondrial apoptosis.

label: Gene expression machinery: transcription, RNA processing, translation
reason: Pol I/II/III transcription, RNA processing/decay and ribosomal translation linked as the core gene-expression pathway; a few signalling outliers.

label: Carbohydrate metabolism and its inborn errors
reason: Glycolysis, gluconeogenesis, glycogen, fructose, galactose and pentose metabolism with their disease variants.

label: Urea cycle and nitrogen/amino acid metabolism
reason: Urea cycle enzymes and defects, arginine/ornithine/glutamate/aspartate metabolism and ammonium handling.

label: NRF2, HIF and p53 metabolic stress reprogramming
reason: NRF2 antioxidant/PPP gene regulation and HIF-driven glycolysis linked as redox/oxygen-stress transcriptional control of metabolism.

label: TGF-beta receptor/SMAD signalling and cancer mutants
reason: TGFBR/SMAD signalling, its regulation and cancer mutants, with RUNX3 as a TGF-beta effector.

label: Replication stress, fork protection and DNA topology
reason: Fork reversal, replication regulation, R-loops, DNA topology and damage-response repair.

label: Synapse assembly and postsynaptic organisation
reason: Neurexin/neuroligin-driven pre/postsynaptic assembly, receptor clustering and excitatory/inhibitory transmission.

label: Type 2 immunity: Th2, mast cells, eosinophils, IgE
reason: Th2 differentiation, IL-4/5/13/33 signalling, FcepsilonRI mast cell activation and eosinophil responses.

label: MET/ERBB receptor tyrosine kinase signalling
reason: MET, EGFR/ERBB, PTK6 and adaptor (GRB2/SHC/PI3K) downstream RTK signalling.

label: Meiosis and spermatogenesis
reason: Meiotic recombination, synapsis and male germ-cell development.

label: Drug reward and addiction behaviour
reason: Responses to cocaine, amphetamine, nicotine, ethanol, opioids and dopaminergic reward learning.

label: Nuclear receptor control of lipid/energy metabolism
reason: SREBP, LXR, PPARA, PGC-1alpha and clock nuclear receptors regulating cholesterol, lipid and glucose metabolism.

label: Cardiomyocyte and vascular smooth muscle growth
reason: Cardiac muscle and VSMC proliferation, differentiation and phenotypic switching linked by shared muscle growth/SRF programmes in heart and vessel wall.

label: Transition/heavy metal ion homeostasis and detoxification
reason: Zinc, copper, manganese, cadmium transport, metallothioneins and MTF1 metal response.

label: miRNA/siRNA silencing and mRNA decay
reason: Small RNA biogenesis and silencing plus ARE-binding protein and deadenylation-mediated mRNA turnover.

label: Melanocyte pigmentation and MITF programme
reason: MITF-M regulation, melanosome/lysosome-related organelle biogenesis and melanin synthesis.

label: Class I cytokine receptor JAK-STAT signalling
reason: IL-6 family, GH, prolactin, leptin and thrombopoietin receptors signalling via JAK-STAT and body growth.

label: B-vitamin (B1, B2, B12) transport and metabolism
reason: Cobalamin, thiamine and riboflavin uptake, transport, metabolism and deficiency disorders.

label: Antimicrobial peptides and mucosal defence
reason: Defensins, antimicrobial peptide production and killing of microbes at mucosal surfaces.

label: Mitophagy and mitochondrial dynamics
reason: PINK1-Parkin and receptor mitophagy, mitochondrial fission/fusion and protein targeting to mitochondria.

label: Purinergic ATP/adenosine signalling
reason: P2Y/P1 receptors, ATP release and hydrolysis, and resulting calcium signalling.

label: Sarcoplasmic reticulum calcium handling in muscle
reason: RyR, SERCA and NCX control of cytosolic calcium regulating cardiac and skeletal contraction.

label: Cytokine-JAK-STAT signalling with type 2 immunity
reason: Broad interleukin/interferon receptor signalling plus a Th2/mast cell/eosinophil subtheme, linked by cytokine-receptor JAK-STAT signalling in lymphocyte effector responses.

label: Hindbrain, cranial nerve and spinal cord development
reason: Hindbrain/brainstem development, cranial nerve and motor neuron specification and migration; a few behavioural outliers.

label: Neuroendocrine control of feeding, growth and stress
reason: Appetite/leptin/ghrelin, GH/prolactin and HPA-axis corticosteroid regulation linked as hypothalamic-pituitary endocrine axes.
